cc:Work.dc:title: Happy Hydro

cc:Agent.dc:title: This work is marked CC0 1.0 Universal. To view a copy of this mark, visit https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

cc:Work.dc:description: A depiction of production of electricity from water flow through a dam. The extraction and use of petroleum products for fuel releases poisons into our environment and harms us directly and indirectly. Clean and renewable hydroelectric energy should be used instead.
